arguments.command: cd /workspace && for f in examples/*.in.native; do echo "=== $f"; out=$(/workspace/tmp/engine2 < $f); exp=$(cat ${f//.in./.out}); if [ "$(echo "$out" | tr -s ' \n' ' ')" = "$(echo "$exp" | tr -s ' \n' ' ')" ]; then echo MATCH; else echo DIFF; echo "got: $out"; echo "exp: $exp"; fi; done
